זְמַן מַתַּן תּוֹרָתֵנוּ רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת תַּמֻז. [ליקו"מ רי"ז]
זִכְרוּ תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת תַּמֻז. [ליקו"מ רי"ז]
זֵיעָה רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת זֶה הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה יְיָ. [ליקו"מ ח"ב ו']
segments.en:
[Cross-reference from Section 12.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 83

 תפה — אל אלקים / תהלים
 
 Gematria

 Tapeh (תפה — a word/name in the source) = gematria of El Elokim in full spelling = gematria of Tehillim = 485. [Cross-references from Section 1.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 205

 תפלין — נפתלי
 
 Tziroof

 Tefillin (תפלין, "phylacteries") — its letters are a permutation of נפתלי (Naftali, the tribe). The binding of tefillin and the tribe of Naftali share their letters — Naftali, described as a swift deer, embodies the swift binding of holiness.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 47

 ת'קיעה ש'ברים ת'רועה — קשת / תר"ת
 
 Roshay Saveivos (×2)

 The three shofar sounds — Tekiah, Shevarim, Teruah — yield two first-letter acronyms:

 (1) קשת (kashes, "bow / rainbow") [cross-reference from Section 19];

 (2) תר"ת (tarat — the acronym itself, referring to the sequence).

 And: ת'קיעה ת'רועה ת'קיעה — the bracketing pattern of Tekiah-Teruah-Tekiah also spells תר"ת.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 42; II:88; Sichos HaRan 180

 תִּקְעוּ — ע"ב + ריו ב' פעמים
 
 Gematria

 Tik'u (תִּקְעוּ, "blow [the shofar]!" [Psalms 81:4]) = gematria of the Name 72 plus Reish-Yud-Vov twice (72 + 216 + 216 = 504). [Cross-reference from Section 16.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 46

 ת"ק שדי — יתקדש
 
 Tziroof

 Tak Sha-dai (ת"ק שדי, "the power of Sha-dai") — its letters are contained in יתקדש (Yiskadash — the second word of Kaddish). [Cross-reference from Section 10.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 177

 תרדמה — תרגום
 
 Gematria

 Tardemah (תרדמה, "deep sleep" [Genesis 2:21 — G-d's deep sleep upon Adam before creating Eve]) = gematria of תרגום (Targum, "Aramaic translation [of the Torah]").
